goodsServices.description: 第009類:電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；資料處理機，資料儲存裝置；微處理器；介面卡；積體電路，晶片（半導體）；半導體及智慧卡；智慧卡控制器；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用之控制器；用於對無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤作建立、程式設計、控制、編碼、掃描、讀取及解譯之電腦硬體及軟體；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用掃描器、讀取機及寫入機；用於對無線射頻辨識晶片及無線射頻辨識標籤作掃描、讀取及詮釋之天線；近場通訊應用技術用電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即近場通訊應用技術用積體電路、晶片、二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；ＩＣ卡、電子晶片卡；用以確定持電子旅遊車票乘客之票價之資料處理設備及軟體；上述商品的零組配件，即用以開發及測試上述各商品之電腦軟體及電腦硬體。 第037類:提供下列商品之保養、安裝及修理服務：電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；資料處理機，資料儲存裝置；微處理器；介面卡；積體電路，晶片（半導體）；半導體及智慧卡；智慧卡控制器；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用之控制器；用於無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤作建立、程式設計、控制、編碼、掃描、讀取及解譯之電腦硬體；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用掃描器、讀取機及寫入機；用於對無線射頻辨識晶片及無線射頻辨識標籤作掃描、讀取及詮釋之天線；近場通訊應用技術用電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即近場通訊應用技術用積體電路、晶片、二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；ＩＣ卡、電子晶片卡；用以確定持電子旅遊車票乘客之票價之資料處理設備。有關前述服務之諮詢顧問及資訊提供服務。 第042類:電腦程式設計服務；有關用於對無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤作建立、程式設計、控制、編碼、掃描、讀取及解譯之軟體，以及用以確定持電子旅遊車票乘客之票價之軟體之安裝、修理及維護服務。提供下列商品之研究、設計及開發服務：電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；資料處理機，資料儲存裝置；微處理器；介面卡；積體電路，晶片（半導體）；半導體及智慧卡；智慧卡控制器；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用之控制器；用於無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤作建立、程式設計、控制、編碼、掃描、讀取及解譯之電腦硬體及軟體；無線射頻辨識晶片及標籤用掃描器、讀取機及寫入機；用於對無線射頻辨識晶片及無線射頻辨識標籤作掃描、讀取及詮釋之天線；近場通訊應用技術用電子、電工及電磁模組及其零件及組件，即近場通訊應用技術用積體電路、晶片、二極體、電晶體、半導體及半導體元件；ＩＣ卡、電子晶片卡；用以確定持電子旅遊車票乘客之票價之資料處理設備及軟體。客製化應用軟體設計及程式設計；有關前述服務之諮詢顧問及資訊提供服務。
goodsServices.translation: Class 009: Electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components, namely diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components; data processors, data storage devices; microprocessors; interface cards; integrated circuits, chips (Semiconductors); semiconductors and smart cards; smart card controllers; controllers for radio frequency identification chips and tags; used to create, program, control, encode, scan, read and interpret radio frequency identification chips and tags Translated computer hardware and software; scanners, readers and writers for radio frequency identification chips and tags; antennas for scanning, reading and interpreting radio frequency identification chips and radio frequency identification tags; near field Electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components for communication application technology, namely integrated circuits, chips, diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components for near field communication application technology; IC cards, electronic chip cards; Data processing equipment and software used to determine fares for passengers holding electronic travel tickets; spare parts for the above-mentioned products, that is, computer software and computer hardware used to develop and test each of the above-mentioned products. Class 037: Provision of maintenance, installation and repair services for the following goods: electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components, namely diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components; data processors, data storage devices; micro Processor; interface card; integrated circuit, chip (semiconductor); semiconductor and smart card; smart card controller; controller for radio frequency identification chips and tags; used for the creation, programming, and programming of radio frequency identification chips and tags Computer hardware for controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting; scanners, readers and writers for radio frequency identification chips and tags; used for scanning and reading radio frequency identification chips and radio frequency identification tags Antennas obtained and interpreted; electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components for near field communication application technology, namely integrated circuits, chips, diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components for near field communication application technology; IC card, electronic chip card; data processing equipment used to determine the fare of passengers holding electronic travel tickets. Consulting and information provision services related to the aforementioned services. Class 042: Computer programming services; related software for the creation, programming, control, encoding, scanning, reading and interpretation of radio frequency identification chips and tags, and for determining the tickets of passengers holding electronic travel tickets Priced software installation, repair and maintenance services. Providing research, design and development services for the following products: electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components, namely diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components; data processors, data storage devices; microprocessors; interfaces Card; integrated circuit, chip (semiconductor); semiconductor and smart card; smart card controller; controller for radio frequency identification chips and tags; used for the creation, programming, control, encoding, etc. of radio frequency identification chips and tags. Computer hardware and software for scanning, reading and interpretation; scanners, readers and writers for RFID chips and tags; used to scan, read and write RFID chips and RFID tags Interpreted antennas; electronic, electrical and electromagnetic modules and their parts and components for near field communication application technology, namely integrated circuits, chips, diodes, transistors, semiconductors and semiconductor components for near field communication application technology; IC cards , Electronic chip card; data processing equipment and software used to determine the fare of passengers holding electronic travel tickets. Customized application software design and programming; consulting and information provision services related to the aforementioned services.
